name: hxn-gpu
description: One GPU API for Haxe over the hxn GPU drivers: Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D 12, OpenGL ES, WebGPU and WebGL2, with features and limits per device
releasenote: Blend what a render pipeline draws, write part of a texture, set viewports and scissors, keep a pass's target, read vertex buffers from an offset, draw into several color targets in one pass, and test and write depth. GLES and WebGL2 frames are upright. Needs hxn-gpu-metal 0.2.3, -vulkan 0.3.3, -d3d12 0.2.3, -gles 0.3.3, -webgpu 0.3.6, -webgl2 0.3.5.
